description: Correct an existing timesheet's start/end time, area, meal break or supervisor comment. Times cannot be in the future. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/update.

area_id.description: Area (OperationalUnit id) the time was worked in.

end_time.description: Timesheet end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

start_time.description: Timesheet start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

name: deputy_update_timesheet
title: Update a timesheet
